chunks: Say: 'Each one acts according to his disposition, but your Lord knows well who follow the right path.'

key_terms.أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا: the one most guided to the path
key_terms.شَاكِلَتِهِ: his disposition, character, or prevailing method of action

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that each person acts according to their 'shakilah' (disposition/method)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'shakilah' is often interpreted as the innate disposition or dominant character trait that guides an individual's actions, reflecting the interplay between free will and divine decree. This verse reassures the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) that ultimate guidance is in Allah's hands, a concept central to the Shia understanding of divine justice and the role of the Imams as guides. It underscores that while humans act according to their nature, Allah's knowledge encompasses the true state of their hearts and their ultimate destination.
